name: AuthorityPrompt AI Visibility Checker
author: authorityprompt

sections.description:
AuthorityPrompt helps WordPress site owners check AI-readable signals, generate a virtual llms.txt file, publish an optional badge, and create drafts for AI-readable company records and trusted sources.

The plugin checks:

  • JSON-LD
  • Organization schema
  • FAQ schema
  • llms.txt
  • AuthorityPrompt AI-readable profile availability

The plugin does not automatically publish verified claims or mutate AuthorityPrompt verified facts. Trusted source and profile submissions are drafts.

Privacy

The plugin does not send data to AuthorityPrompt on activation, deactivation, or ordinary page loads. It sends data only when a site administrator explicitly clicks an action in the AuthorityPrompt settings page. The plugin does not send the WordPress administrator email address or an email hash.

External services

This plugin connects to the AuthorityPrompt API at https://authorityprompt.com/api/v1/wordpress-plugin to provide AI-readiness checks, virtual llms.txt generation support, optional badge status syncing, AI-readable profile drafts, and trusted source drafts.

The service is provided by AuthorityPrompt. Terms: https://authorityprompt.com/legal/terms-conditions. Privacy policy: https://authorityprompt.com/legal/privacy-policy.

Data is sent only after a WordPress administrator explicitly clicks one of the plugin actions. The plugin sends the site URL, site domain, WordPress version, plugin version, scan signals such as whether JSON-LD, Organization schema, FAQ schema, and llms.txt are present, and any draft content the administrator chooses to submit. The plugin does not send data to AuthorityPrompt during activation or deactivation, and it does not send the WordPress administrator email address or an email hash.

The AuthorityPrompt API uses this data to return or store the requested result: a scan score, generated llms.txt content, badge status, a profile draft, or a trusted source draft. Draft submissions are not committed as verified facts automatically.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress Admin.
  3. Open Settings -> AuthorityPrompt.
  4. Run an AI visibility check.
  5. Optionally connect AuthorityPrompt, generate llms.txt, and enable the badge.
